curation.selection: Mid-range file-size candidates, measured duration and chronological visual inspection; clear stages and representative complementary layouts. Method notes are curator interpretations.

episodes.selection_reason: Both sequences show readable intermediate and final digits, with five-digit and four-digit examples providing useful variation.
episodes.method: Recognize the live digits, order them descending, and place each upright on the corresponding pad using the reachable hand.
episodes.applicability: Use the live digit identities and number of pads; the demonstrated digit values and count are not instructions.

episodes.selection_reason: Both show a complete stable multi-level structure and visible two-handed board support, with different scattered starting positions.
